summary:
#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Role not specified, Happiness Research Institute) – [Monday, 26 August 2024 at 19.26]:**
  - Submitted a filled research proposal form for SensorKit variables collection through the Mood Snapshot app.
  - Attached multiple documents including proposal forms, IRB memo, and consent documents.
  - *Key quote:* "Please find attached the filled research proposal form to collect the specified SensorKit variables through the Mood Snapshot app (ID #6503913823)."

- **[SensorKit Request] (Review Team, Apple) – [Monday, 26 August 2024 at 19.26]:**
  - Requested an updated copy of the SensorKit proposal due to issues with text boxes on the first page.
  - *Key quote:* "Can you send an updated copy of your SensorKit proposal? It seems that the text boxes on the first page of the document have been modified so we can't copy the content inside of them to view it."

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Role not specified, Happiness Research Institute) – [Tuesday, 27 August 2024 at 16.41]:**
  - Resubmitted the proposal with corrected PDFs and pasted content of text boxes.
  - Provided details about the research team, project title, and study design.
  - *Key quote:* "PI Name: Meik Wiking (wiking@happinessresearchinstitute.com) Co-Investigators: Camilla Michalski (michalski@happinessresearchinstitute.com) Micah Kaats (kaats@happinessresearchinstitute.com)"

- **[SensorKit Request] (Review Team, Apple) – [Tuesday, 27 August 2024 at 16.41]:**
  - Acknowledged receipt of the corrected documents.
  - *Key quote:* "Thank you, this works! ~SensorKit Review Team"

- **[SensorKit Request] (Review Team, Apple) – [Tuesday, 27 August 2024 at 16.41]:**
  - Explained the two stages of entitlements: Development and Distribution.
  - Provided links for the addendum and collaborator agreement.
  - *Key quote:* "We approve the development entitlement pending agreement to the addendum to the SensorKit Addendum."

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Role not specified, Happiness Research Institute) – [Friday, 30 August 2024 at 00.41]:**
  - Noted missing data types (Heart Rate and Wrist Temperature) in the Addendum.
  - Requested an updated link for the collaborator agreement.
  - *Key quote:* "Could you address the missing data types and update us on this? We will submit the Addendum once these issues are resolved."

- **[SensorKit Request] (Review Team, Apple) – [Friday, 30 August 2024 at 00.41]:**
  - Clarified that the form doesn't support the two newer data types but assured they will be granted.
  - Provided an updated link for the collaborator agreement.
  - *Key quote:* "Right now the form doesn't support those 2 data types since they are newer, but please complete the Addendum form without them."

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Role not specified, Happiness Research Institute) – [Monday, 9 September 2024 at 17.35]:**
  - Confirmed signing of agreements and inquired about any outstanding items.
  - *Key quote:* "We’ve signed both those agreements from our end – is there anything else outstanding at this point?"

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Role not specified, Happiness Research Institute) – [Date not specified]:**
  - Requested an update on the SensorKit request, noting signed agreements and submitted ethics approval letter.
  - *Key quote:* "Could you please provide an update on our SensorKit request? We haven’t heard anything for a few weeks."

#### **2. Timeline**

- **[26 August 2024]:** Camilla submitted the initial research proposal.
- **[27 August 2024]:** SensorKit Team requested an updated proposal and later acknowledged receipt.
- **[30 August 2024]:** Camilla pointed out missing data types in the Addendum.
- **[9 September 2024]:** Camilla confirmed signing of agreements and sought updates.

#### **3. Key Events/Issues**

- **Issue 1:** Missing data types (Heart Rate and Wrist Temperature) in the Addendum.
  - Resolution: SensorKit Team assured these would be granted despite not being in the form.
- **Feedback Submission:** Camilla provided feedback on the Addendum and collaborator agreement link.
- **Access/Login Issues:** None reported.

#### **4. Action Items**

- **Pending:**
  - Completion of Addendum submission by Camilla's team.
  - Approval of distribution entitlement by SensorKit Team.
- **Completed:**
  - Submission of research proposal and ethics documents.
  - Signing of Addendum and collaborator agreement.

#### **5. Technical Details**

- **Account/Login Info:** App ID #6503913823 (Mood Snapshot app).
- **Study ID/Project Code:** Case-ID: 8692905.

#### **6. Next Steps**

- **Action 1:** Camilla's team to complete and submit the Addendum.
- **Action 2:** SensorKit Team to grant development entitlement and review distribution entitlement request.
